scope: Existing A/B source trajectories only. C and D trajectory content remains unopened by this mining run.
held_semantics: At the anchor frame: bilateral force-bearing descendant fingers, force>0.01, no external force-bearing contact. Previous frames may have different labels. No future frame is an input.
hard_negative_definition: Anchor bilateral force-bearing fingers AND external force-bearing contact, closed command, TCP<75mm; exactly not held under unchanged physical rule. Frame history at t-3..t must exist.
original_supplement_selection: Original predicate required all4frames to be visible, nonheld, externally supported, near, closed-command, descend_named_block. This audit separately counts transient anchor facts and stable4 requirements.
visibility: Supplement has saved exact mask pixel counts in private audit. Core full video has only RGB colour-pixel proxy; not exact segmentation. Visibility is reported separately, never invented.
public_input_contract: Existing reader requires original RGB, per-frame visible masks and robot_obs. Decoded MP4 is lossy and no substitute mask may be generated from private states.
training: No training unless complete original public windows and held-out development design are feasible; no model or controller change.
prior_preflight: Supplement A/B preliminary trace inspection already showed3stable roots versus12anchor roots; protocol freezes the full audit definitions, not a claimed blind discovery.
